answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is 5x and called out as primary-region-only, which is the pattern memory_b2 associated with a clean regional failover that restored latency without dropping traffic. Rollback is ruled out by compliance even though memory_b1 shows rollbacks have worked. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) fail-fast and would shed settlement writes, violating the no-lost-writes objective. memory_b3 is about headroom provisioned before a peak, not a reactive add during one; memory_b5 offloaded report/dashboard reads, not heavy settlement writes. One intervention has to move writes off the degraded primary. Flagging downstream settlement risk (in-flight writes, replication, duplicate/lost settlements). Verifying memory_b2 because the archived record may contain peak-write or consistency caveats that the consolidation omitted.
